messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "not recommended to take 2 cyclobenzaprine 10 mg at the same time"
set: ["not recommended to take 2 cyclobenzaprine 10 mg at the same time", "take at same time each day", "take at same time every day", "take at around the same time each day", "take with food at the same time each day", "do not take two 10 mg tablets at once", "taken at approximately the same time each day", "can be taken any time of the day but take at the same time each day", "do not use different brands of semaglutide at the same time", "take prescribed dose every four to six hours at the same time every day", "do not take two doses at one time", "take your next dose at the regular time", "allergy to Cyclobenzaprine", "Take your next dose at the usual time", "Cyclobenzaprine", "do not take more than recommended"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
